title: Cute Ghast
description: Cute Ghast replaces the scary Minecraft Ghast with a softer, adorable, vanilla-friendly version
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3decfdfb02b5c71c1254d0d8b770ae53665eff6.png)

Cute Ghast is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack designed to make the Nether a little less terrifying. This pack replaces the default Ghast texture with a much cuter version featuring expressive eyes, softer shading, and an overall more adorable design inspired by cozy and stylized Minecraft aesthetics.

The pack keeps the vanilla feel of Minecraft while giving Ghasts a fresh and wholesome look that fits perfectly into cute, pastel, cottagecore, or cozy-themed gameplay. Whether you are building in the Nether, exploring fortresses, or just want less creepy flying mobs in your world, Cute Ghast adds a fun and charming touch to your adventure.

Features:

Cute redesigned Ghast texture
Vanilla-friendly style
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Works great with cozy and aesthetic texture packs
Perfect for screenshots, roleplay, and relaxing gameplay

Turn the Nether into a slightly happier place with Cute Ghast!
